newsitem.title: MEXICO: 12 reported dead in Mexico mudslide.
newsitem.headline: 12 reported dead in Mexico mudslide.

text.p: Twelve people were killed in a mudslide in southern Mexico, television network Televisa reported on Wednesday.
Televisa said a hillside gave way in the town of Huautla de Jimenez, in southern Oaxaca state, some 155 miles (250 km) southeast of Mexico City. It gave no further details.
State and federal government officials were not immediately available for comment on the report.
